THE ELECTRICAL AGE JANUARY, 1954
Women and the New Age
The New Year is heralding developments which were only a remote possibility a few years ago. Just as fifty years ago the shape of the Comet airliner would not have been discerned in the Wright brothers' early flying machine, so even in the immediate pre-war period the possibility of atomic-fired power stations would not have been considered to be within the lifetime of the present generation. Today, however, it is announced that the first atomic energy power station is being built in Cumberland and, according to "The Times," in about two years' time it will be feeding electricity into the national grid.
